summary: Stellantis N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a press release reporting estimated Q3 2026 consolidated shipments of about 1.3 million units, down 1% year-over-year. Enlarged Europe shipments rose roughly 10% on BEV growth and Leapmotor volumes, while North America fell about 12% on planned summer production downtime, chiefly Jeep Grand Cherokee and Compass; Middle East Africa declined about 21% on Türkiye weakness. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory terms are stated. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; watch quarterly shipment-to-revenue conversion and North American inventory.
